title: Swedish security service calls him in over the Som find

tellings.quote: were home they I got the call from the Swedish let's say it's like FBI in Sweden

plain: In 2015, after his team came home from the find off Sweden that the episode calls a UFO on the seafloor, the Swedish security service called the treasure hunter Dennis Asberg in. Asberg tells Michels he took the call himself, from what he describes as "like FBI in Sweden." If so, it would mean the state took a quiet interest in what his team had found.
